title: Mouse waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M 30 78 Q 10 85 12 70 Q 13 62 22 64' fill='none' stroke='#ff9ec7' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='68' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#b8b8d8'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='72' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#e8e8f8'/>
  <!-- left ear -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='42' r='12' fill='#b8b8d8'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='42' r='7' fill='#ffb6d9'/>
  <!-- right ear -->
  <circle cx='64' cy='42' r='12' fill='#b8b8d8'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='42' r='7' fill='#ffb6d9'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='52' rx='20' ry='17' fill='#c8c8e8'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='50' r='3.5' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='50' r='3.5' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='49' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='49' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='57' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#ff6fa5'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='30' y1='55' x2='42' y2='57' stroke='#9a9ac0' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='30' y1='59' x2='42' y2='59' stroke='#9a9ac0' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='57' x2='66' y2='55' stroke='#9a9ac0' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='59' x2='66' y2='59' stroke='#9a9ac0' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- smiling mouth -->
  <path d='M 44 61 Q 48 65 52 61' fill='none' stroke='#9a9ac0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- left arm (down) -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='72' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#b8b8d8'/>
  <!-- right arm waving -->
  <g>
    <line x1='66' y1='64' x2='78' y2='46' stroke='#b8b8d8' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- paw -->
    <circle cx='80' cy='42' r='7' fill='#d8d8f0'/>
    <circle cx='77' cy='36' r='2.5' fill='#d8d8f0'/>
    <circle cx='81' cy='35' r='2.5' fill='#d8d8f0'/>
    <circle cx='85' cy='37' r='2.5' fill='#d8d8f0'/>
  </g>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='86' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#ffb6d9'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='86' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#ffb6d9'/>
  <!-- wave lines -->
  <path d='M 88 32 Q 92 28 88 24' fill='none' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M 92 38 Q 97 34 94 29' fill='none' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
